parameters.query:
SELECT
  ar.student_id,
  s.name,
  s.slack_id,
  s.course,
  s.mentor_id,
  ar.risk_score,
  ar.risk_level,
  ar.urgency,
  ar.student_state,
  ar.primary_drivers,
  ar.supporting_evidence,
  ar.draft_message,
  ar.mentor_summary,
  ar.dashboard_label,
  ar.analyzed_at
FROM analysis_results ar
LEFT JOIN students_n8n s ON s.student_id = ar.student_id
ORDER BY ar.risk_score DESC;

parameters.jsCode:
const students = $input.all().map(r => r.json);

return [{
  json: {
    total:        students.length,
    high_risk:    students.filter(s => s.risk_level === 'high').length,
    medium_risk:  students.filter(s => s.risk_level === 'medium').length,
    low_risk:     students.filter(s => s.risk_level === 'low').length,
    generated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
    students: students.map(s => ({
      student_id:          s.student_id,
      name:                s.name,
      slack_id:            s.slack_id,
      course:              s.course,
      mentor_id:           s.mentor_id,
      risk_score:          s.risk_score,
      risk_level:          s.risk_level,
      urgency:             s.urgency,
      student_state:       s.student_state,
      primary_drivers:     s.primary_drivers     || [],
      supporting_evidence: s.supporting_evidence || [],
      draft_message:       s.draft_message       || '',
      mentor_summary:      s.mentor_summary      || '',
      dashboard_label:     s.dashboard_label     || '',
      analyzed_at:         s.analyzed_at,
    }))
  }
}];
